VENDOR WEBCAST

Exchange 2007 High Availability Leveraging the VMware Platform









       
         
          PRE-REGISTER FOR WEBCAST 














WHEN:
LIVE! February 26, 2008 at 2:00 PM EST (1900 GMT)


SPEAKER:
Mark Arnold, Exchange MVP


      
      SPONSOR:  
AppAssure


SUMMARY:
Learn how to leverage virtualization to build a defensible and cost-effective business continuity strategy for mission-critical Exchange environments quickly and easily. In this webcast, Mark Arnold, Microsoft Exchange MVP, will discuss how to:

Ensure predictable and reliable recoveries from any Exchange failure
Deliver highly available Exchange-leveraging virtualization
Provide application portability for DR testing and e-discovery.
